iron_skin.name: Iron Skin Sutra
iron_skin.desc: Qi packed under the skin turns blows aside. You take 15% less damage.
iron_skin.hint: Some say the old warrens were dug by monks before the goblins came.

wind_step.name: Wind Step
wind_step.desc: Press V to burst forward six metres, through any attack. The nanites in your legs fire all at once.
wind_step.hint: Goblins are clumsy, but they never stand still. Watch enough of them and you learn how they move.

qi_burst.name: Qi Burst
qi_burst.desc: Press F to release a ring of qi that strikes everything around you for double damage.
qi_burst.hint: The shrine in the village is older than the village. Sit with it long enough.

spirit_sense.name: Spirit Sense
spirit_sense.desc: Hidden things hum. Secret walls, unopened chests and lore stones near you glow faintly.
spirit_sense.hint: Little Rin finds everything. Ask her how.

mountain_breath.name: Breath of the Mountain
mountain_breath.desc: Meditation draws twice as much qi, anywhere.
mountain_breath.hint: Written in the crypt, where the dead have nothing to do but breathe.

bone_reading.name: Bone Reading
bone_reading.desc: You read the qi left in bone: crypt dead drop half again as many bone shards, and you heal a little from each kill.
bone_reading.hint: Kill enough of the crypt's dead and their bones start to speak.

silver_vein.name: Silver Vein Insight
silver_vein.desc: You feel ore through stone: every vein you mine gives one more.
silver_vein.hint: A miner's prayer is carved somewhere in the flooded seam.

thousand_cuts.name: Thousand Cuts
thousand_cuts.desc: Your blade moves before you think. Attacks come 30% faster.
thousand_cuts.hint: The Foreman never stopped working. Neither should you.

nanite_resonance.name: Nanite Resonance
nanite_resonance.desc: Your nanites sing with the Sanctum's. All qi you gain is increased by 25%.
nanite_resonance.hint: In the Sanctum, the walls remember what the nanites were for.

sword_heart.name: Sword Heart
sword_heart.desc: A master's understanding of the blade, passed on whole. Every strike you make deals 15% more damage.
sword_heart.hint: A sword sage died somewhere under Eliet, and his bones were never found.

forge_sense.name: Forge Sense
forge_sense.desc: You hear a blade's flaws before it's finished. Smithing success +8%, and finer work more often.
forge_sense.hint: Ten levels of honest work at the anvil changes how you listen.

furnace_heart.name: Furnace Heart
furnace_heart.desc: Your own qi steadies the furnace. Alchemy success +8%, and every pill you swallow gives 10% more qi.
furnace_heart.hint: An alchemist who has burned enough pills learns to burn steadier.

healers_touch.name: Healer's Touch
healers_touch.desc: You know where a wound wants to close. Medicine success +8%; you heal 4 HP whenever you defeat something.
healers_touch.hint: Mend enough wounds and your own start mending themselves.

stone_whisper.name: Stone Whisper
stone_whisper.desc: Stone tells you where it's rich. One more from every vein, and glittering veins give up more gems.
stone_whisper.hint: Miners who've broken enough rock say it starts talking back.

verdant_eye.name: Verdant Eye
verdant_eye.desc: Plants show you what they're good for. Much more chance of extra herbs.
verdant_eye.hint: Pick enough herbs and you start seeing them before you look.

still_water.name: Still Water
still_water.desc: An angler's patience, carried into cultivation. Meditation is 25% faster.
still_water.hint: The water teaches the patient something it never tells the hungry.

hunters_step.name: Hunter's Step
hunters_step.desc: You move like something that doesn't want to be seen. You take 8% less damage, and animals don't flee as far.
hunters_step.hint: Track enough game and you learn how not to be tracked.

jewel_mind.name: Jeweller's Mind
jewel_mind.desc: You see the flaw lines in a stone. Jewelcrafting success +10%, finer settings.
jewel_mind.hint: Cut enough stones and the next one shows you where to cut.

evergreen_body.name: Evergreen Body
evergreen_body.desc: Like the grove, you grow back. Every kill mends 10 HP, and your body holds 8% more life.
evergreen_body.hint: Somewhere in the Grove, the trees tell how they outlived the sect that planted them.

ember_meridians.name: Ember Meridians
ember_meridians.desc: Qi runs through you like fire through a bellows. +12% damage.
ember_meridians.hint: The forge-masters cut their method into the anvils.

slag_breaker.name: Slag Breaker
slag_breaker.desc: You've learned where brutes break. You take 10% less damage.
slag_breaker.hint: Break enough of the Forge's brutes and you'll learn where they crack.

terracotta_stance.name: Terracotta Stance
terracotta_stance.desc: Stand like the buried army stood for a thousand years. You take 12% less damage.
terracotta_stance.hint: The general who drilled the clay army left his drill book behind.

sword_intent.name: Sword Intent
sword_intent.desc: Not a technique -- a decision. +20% damage, and you strike 10% faster.
sword_intent.hint: The Sword Saint left one disciple. The disciple is still waiting.

lotus_breathing.name: Lotus Breathing
lotus_breathing.desc: The Academy's first lesson: breathe like a lotus opening. You cultivate 30% faster.
lotus_breathing.hint: Taught in the Lotus Ascent Academy's library.

flowing_strikes.name: Flowing Strikes
flowing_strikes.desc: Each strike flows into the next. You attack 10% faster.
flowing_strikes.hint: Taught in the Lotus Ascent Academy's library.

lotus_body.name: Lotus Body
lotus_body.desc: A body that closes its wounds like petals at dusk. +12% HP.
lotus_body.hint: Taught in the Lotus Ascent Academy's library.

heart_of_the_lotus.name: Heart of the Lotus
heart_of_the_lotus.desc: Qi gathers to you as water gathers to a pond. +20% qi.
heart_of_the_lotus.hint: Taught in the Lotus Ascent Academy's library.

thousand_petal_guard.name: Thousand-Petal Guard
thousand_petal_guard.desc: Blows slide off a thousand layered petals of qi. 12% less damage taken.
thousand_petal_guard.hint: Taught in the Lotus Ascent Academy's library.

drowned_art.name: Tidal Breath
drowned_art.desc: Breathe like the tide: slow in, slow out.
drowned_art.hint: Hidden somewhere in The Drowned Palace.

cloudruins_art.name: Ascending Breath
cloudruins_art.desc: Breathe as the immortals breathed, and rise.
cloudruins_art.hint: Hidden somewhere in The Fallen Cloud Palace.

fungal_art.name: Rot-Ward Body
fungal_art.desc: Your flesh learns to refuse what rots it.
fungal_art.hint: Hidden somewhere in The Spore-Choked Deeps.

storm_art.name: Lightning Step
storm_art.desc: Strike between one heartbeat and the next.
storm_art.hint: Hidden somewhere in The Thunderhead Spire.

dragonspine_art.name: Dragon's Breath Meridian
dragonspine_art.hint: Hidden somewhere in The Spine of the Sleeping Dragon.

crystal_art.name: Echoing Meridians
crystal_art.desc: Your qi rings back through you on every strike.
crystal_art.hint: Hidden somewhere in The Singing Crystal Caverns.

canopy_art.name: Predator's Patience
canopy_art.desc: Wait for the moment; strike once, and mean it.
canopy_art.hint: Hidden somewhere in The Crimson Canopy.

starmine_art.name: Starfall Body
starmine_art.desc: A body as dense as fallen star-iron.
starmine_art.hint: Hidden somewhere in The Fallen Star Mine.

clockwork_art.name: Perfect Timing
clockwork_art.desc: Your strikes fall on the beat.
clockwork_art.hint: Hidden somewhere in The Clockwork Vaults.

silk_art.name: Web-Sense
silk_art.desc: Feel every tremor in the threads of the world.
silk_art.hint: Hidden somewhere in The Weaver's Halls.

ash_art.name: Ember-Skin
ash_art.desc: Your skin hardens like fired clay.
ash_art.hint: Hidden somewhere in The Ash Dunes.

frost_art.name: Still-Mind Frost
frost_art.desc: A mind as still as ice gathers qi without spilling it.
frost_art.hint: Hidden somewhere in The Frozen Archive.

mirror_art.name: Know Thyself
mirror_art.desc: You have faced yourself and won. Stronger, steadier, whole.
mirror_art.hint: Hidden somewhere in The Mirror Labyrinth.

ghostmarket_art.name: Ghost-Walking
ghostmarket_art.desc: Half here, half not -- blows pass through the half that isn't.
ghostmarket_art.hint: Hidden somewhere in The Night Market of the Dead.
